evidence.title: Envin - Type-safe env validation with live previews
GitHub - turbostarter/envin: Type-safe env validation with live previews

name: Envin
summary: Framework-agnostic, type-safe environment variable validation for JavaScript projects, with an interactive CLI live preview.
description: A TypeScript package and CLI that validates environment variables from a schema you define once, using any Standard Schema validator (Zod, Valibot, ArkType). It separates server and client variables, supports shared presets across packages, and ships an interactive CLI that previews and updates your env in real time during development. Works with Next.js, Vite, Astro and other frameworks.
contains: type-safe env validation from a single schema
works with any Standard Schema validator
interactive CLI with a live preview server
shared presets and extends for monorepos
